system.description: A Focus for a character who commands the wintry power of cold and ice.

abilities.name: Cool Water
abilities.description: Condense water from the air, creating enough potable cold water to sustain five creatures for one day. Action.

abilities.name: Ice Armor
abilities.description: Cover yourself in ice until a ten-minute recovery, easing Might defense rolls to block attacks, reducing cold wounds by one step, and granting a 2-damage cold touch.

abilities.name: Lower Temperature
abilities.description: Make an immediate area up to 20 degrees cooler until a ten-minute recovery. Action to initiate.

abilities.name: Frost Bolt
abilities.description: Emit a ray of cold at a foe within short range for 4 cold damage, or intensify Ice Armor to add 2 damage to its touch and your weapon attacks until a ten-minute recovery. Action.

abilities.name: Ice Slide
abilities.description: Create a smooth ice path to a location within long range and slide there safely along a clear route. Action.

abilities.name: Ice Creation
abilities.description: Create a crude level 3 ice object no larger than yourself; each additional selection doubles its base size. Effort can double its size or extend its distance. Action.

abilities.name: Winter's Grip
abilities.description: Make an Intellect attack against a foe within short range to restrain them in ice. Effort can add 3 cold damage. Action.

abilities.name: Improved Ice Armor
abilities.description: Ice Armor eases Might defense rolls to block attacks by another step, and its cold touch, Frost Bolt, and Winter's Grip deal +1 damage.

abilities.name: Cold Burst
abilities.description: Make an Intellect attack against any number of creatures within short range for 5 cold damage. Effort increases damage or can blind successful targets. Action.

abilities.name: Ice Monster
abilities.description: Create a level 5 snow or ice automaton ally that acts on your commands until a ten-minute recovery. Action to create and action to direct.

abilities.name: Winter Gauntlets
abilities.description: Frost Bolt and cold-enhanced attacks deal +3 damage and restrain creatures hit as with Winter's Grip.
